paper.title_en: Universal Emergence of Bosonic and Fermionic Algebras in a Deterministic Proper-Time Framework
paper.abstract_en: This work develops the deterministic, discrete proper-time framework introduced in our previous work, Eur.\ Phys.\ J.\ C \textbf{86} (2026) 829, in which quantum field theory emerges as an effective infrared description characterized by a running Planck constant. There, the effective quantization scale was inferred from the microscopic multiplicity unresolved by coarse-graining. Here, we provide its dynamical and operatorial realization and extend the construction to fermionic degrees of freedom. First, consistency under changes of macroscopic resolution leads to the structure of the Renormalization Group Equation, while the running Planck constant governs the crossover toward the deterministic regime. Second, we represent the reversible microscopic dynamics through finite-difference translations in field-configuration space. After coarse-graining, the resulting operator-valued canonical commutation relations reproduce the same quantization scale previously obtained from statistical microstate counting, thereby linking microscopic evolution to the emergent canonical algebra. Third, representing the same update within a Grassmann algebra yields the corresponding canonical anticommutation relations. The bosonic and fermionic sectors thus inherit a common effective Planck constant without introducing an independent fermionic update or quantization scale. Finally, we discuss possible implications for high-energy loop amplitudes and effective Hawking radiation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在确定性离散固有时间框架中系统构造了玻色子与费米子的有效正则代数，并将跑动普朗克常数与重整化群方程结构联系起来，理论深度较高、构想新颖；摘要还给出对高能圈振幅与霍金辐射的潜在应用，与黑洞热力学及引力基础问题相关，值得点击阅读全文以核验其微观动力学与粗粒化推导。
decision.title_zh: 确定性固有时间框架中玻色子与费米子代数的普适涌现
decision.abstract_zh: 本工作发展了我们在前作 Eur.\ Phys.\ J.\ C \textbf{86} (2026) 829 中提出的确定性、离散固有时间框架；在该框架中，量子场论作为以跑动普朗克常数为特征的有效红外描述而涌现。在那里，有效量子化标度是由粗粒化未能分辨的微观多重度推断出来的。在这里，我们给出其动力学与算符实现，并将该构造推广到费米子自由度。首先，宏观分辨率变化下的一致性导出了重整化群方程的结构，而跑动普朗克常数则支配着向确定性区域的过渡。其次，我们用场位形空间中的有限差分平移来表示可逆的微观动力学。经过粗粒化后，所得算符值的正则对易关系重现了此前由统计微观态计数得到的同一量子化标度，从而将微观演化与涌现的正则代数联系起来。第三，在 Grassmann 代数内表示同一更新，可得到相应的正则反对易关系。于是，玻色子与费米子扇区继承了一个共同的有效普朗克常数，而无需引入独立的费米子更新或量子化标度。最后，我们讨论了对高能圈振幅与有效霍金辐射的可能含义。
